1368:v1:8380c1413f88.title: Fix(cli): delete a word with Ctrl-Backspace
1368:v1:8380c1413f88.summary: The PR extends the word-delete handler in `MultilineInput` to treat Ctrl+Backspace the same as Alt+Backspace and Ctrl+W, since the previous condition only matched an Alt-like modifier. A test mounts the real component and asserts that pressing Ctrl+Backspace on 'hello world' removes 'world' and leaves the cursor at position 6. The preview shows the existing backspace branch being broadened and a new test block added to cover it.

1259:v1:a4f95e6efc1f.title: Fix MCP tool schema and result handling bug families
1259:v1:a4f95e6efc1f.summary: The PR proposes seven fixes across MCP tool schema handling, result mapping, and agent state representation, including serving JSON Schema tool inputs verbatim instead of zod round-tripping, keeping zod schema instances alive when cloning tool definitions, and mapping text and non-image MCP resources to json instead of media. The preview shows that text resources now flow through mcpContentToToolResultOutputs as json values, and tool definitions are stored as plain JSON Schema in agent state. Regression tests are promoted into a permanent checklist-shaped suite covering wiring, mapping, and type correctness.

1328:v1:bb5bc6f65cae.title: Reload MCP servers and skills after project change in picker
1328:v1:bb5bc6f65cae.summary: This PR addresses an issue where changing projects via the project picker in the CLI doesn't refresh the loaded MCP servers and skills, leaving stale registries from the previous project. It introduces reinitialization of the local agent registry and skill registry after a project change, ensuring that project-specific configurations like `.agents/mcp.json` and `.agents/skills/` are correctly loaded. The change includes an integration test that reproduces the bug by switching from a project without `.agents/` to one with MCP and skill definitions, validating that registries are reloaded properly.

1316:v1:177b758901fb.title: Stop CLI launcher re-downloading installed binary on every launch
1316:v1:177b758901fb.summary: The launcher in cli/release-core/launcher.js now consults a new getUpdateComparisonVersion() helper that falls back to the wrapper version when the metadata cache is missing or unreadable, so an already-installed binary that still exists on disk is no longer treated as unknown and re-downloaded on every startup. The registry URL is also made overridable via CODEBUFF_NPM_REGISTRY_URL so tests can intercept the version check instead of hitting the real npm registry. A new test suite cli/src/__tests__/release/launcher-installed-binary.test.ts covers these startup and background-update scenarios.

1308:v1:555f9dcd16e0.title: Fix stuck model switches from false end-failure in session takeover
1308:v1:555f9dcd16e0.summary: This PR refactors the model_locked takeover flow in `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts` so the deliberate-pick guard, follow-up GET, DELETE, and chat notices all live in `runModelLockedTakeover` with injected collaborators, and the new `planModelLockedSwitch` planner maps the follow-up GET row to `release`, `retry`, or `explain` outcomes. It fixes two false end-failure cases that stranded users for an hour: `ended` rows still inside the server grace window now trigger a release instead of reporting 'ending it failed, run /end-session', and rows that vanished between the lock response and follow-up GET fall through to `retry` without surfacing the missing-row notice. The preview shows a new test file `model-locked-takeover.test.ts` covering active, ended-in-grace, vanished, and ended-past-grace held-row shapes with injected `fetchHeld`/`releaseSlot`/`notify`/`isStale` collaborators.

1302:v1:b9eff978cd65.title: Enhance tests for axiom response assertion
1302:v1:b9eff978cd65.summary: The PR expands test coverage for the Axiom response assertion helper by adding cases for non-throwing complete responses, statusless and partial inputs with an end-anchored regex, and non-object inputs. It addresses three gaps flagged in the description: missing coverage for the complete (non-partial) case, missing statusless input cases, and an unanchored toThrow regex. The preview shows changes confined to common/src/util/__tests__/axiom-complete-response.test.ts.

1292:v1:85e3657e2267.title: Drop orphaned tool results at trim boundary
1292:v1:85e3657e2267.summary: The PR adds a post-trim sweep in `trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit` that removes surviving `role: 'tool'` messages whose `toolCallId` no longer appears in any retained assistant tool-call, closing the gap left by `dropUnansweredToolCalls`. The preview shows new regression tests in `messages.test.ts` covering boundary orphaning, the `keepDuringTruncation` middle case, and a keep-survival guard.

1291:v1:f4522bbee589.title: Guard whitespace-only strings from empty-match file corruption
1291:v1:f4522bbee589.summary: The PR adds a guard in `packages/agent-runtime/src/process-str-replace.ts` so that when the whitespace-insensitive fallback in `tryMatchOldStr` strips a whitespace-only `oldString` to `''`, it reports not-found instead of producing a vacuous empty match. Without this fix, `replaceAll('', newStr)` inserted the new string between every character of the file and the tool returned success with the corrupted content written to disk.

1284:v1:f3da456b874b.title: Fix NaN handling in ttft latency bucket index
1284:v1:f3da456b874b.summary: The `ttftBucketIndex` function in `common/src/util/ttft-histogram.ts` does not validate that the latency input is a finite number, so a `NaN` input propagates through `Math.max` and `Math.log` to produce a `NaN` bucket index. The preview shows the fix special-casing only `Number.isNaN` to route to bucket 0, while letting `Infinity` values flow through the normal calculation where they clamp to the top bucket.

1274:v1:f70b1a2c23c1.title: Feat(cli): scroll the transcript three lines per wheel notch
1274:v1:f70b1a2c23c1.summary: The PR proposes adding a stateless `ConstantScrollAccel` class to the Freebuff CLI so that a single mouse wheel notch scrolls the chat transcript by three lines instead of the default one line. It passes this accelerator through a new `scrollAcceleration` prop on the `<scrollbox>` in `chat.tsx`, which OpenTUI's `ScrollBoxRenderable` already supports via a setter and constructor. The change adds an integration test that drives real wheel events at a rendered scrollbox to verify the full OpenTUI event chain moves exactly three lines per notch.

1258:v1:5400107fb79b.title: Wait for current turn to finish before auto-update restart
1258:v1:5400107fb79b.summary: PR #1258 proposes a fix for issue #994 where the CLI wrapper unconditionally stops the running process during an auto-update, even if the user is mid-turn. The patch adds a cross-process activity marker written by the binary side via `cli/src/utils/run-activity-marker.ts` for the duration of a turn, and a corresponding `waitForRunIdle(pid)` polling function in `cli/release-core/launcher.js` that waits for the marker to clear before stopping the process. The preview shows `waitForRunIdle` being called in the launcher's update flow after staging the binary and before stopping the running process, with a bounded 10-minute wait and stale marker cleanup on spawn.

1256:v1:29b9b2c86b2a.title: Queue plan, interview, and review mid-turn submits instead of interrupting in-progress runs
1256:v1:29b9b2c86b2a.summary: The /plan, /interview, and /review slash commands currently bypass the busy-state check that other mid-turn submit paths use, calling sendMessage() directly and forcing registerActiveRun to abort an in-flight run. The fix routes these commands through the same isStreaming || streamMessageIdRef.current || isChainInProgressRef.current guard and falls back to addToQueue() when the agent is busy. The diff preview shows the accompanying test coverage in router-steering.test.ts asserting queued delivery for both input-mode submits and inline-arg invocations.

1368:v2:8380c1413f88.title: Fix(cli): delete a word with Ctrl+Backspace
1368:v2:8380c1413f88.summary: The PR updates the multiline input handler in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` to treat Ctrl+Backspace as a word-delete shortcut alongside the existing Alt+Backspace and Ctrl+W bindings, matching common terminal editing expectations. It also adds a test in `cli/src/components/__tests__/multiline-input.test.tsx` that mounts the component and verifies pressing Ctrl+Backspace on `hello world` removes the trailing word, leaving `hello ` with the cursor at position 6.

1259:v2:6e049813395f.title: Fix MCP tool schema and result handling bugs
1259:v2:6e049813395f.summary: The PR overhauls how MCP tool schemas and results are stored and mapped, fixing sessions that died from cyclic Zod instances in serialized state and tool results that poisoned prompt builds. It extracts content mapping into a dedicated module, stores schemas verbatim as plain JSON Schema, and repairs schema-guided decoding of string-encoded union parameters. New regression tests cover text/image/non-image resource mapping, loose MCP schema survival, zod-safe cloning, and non-image file part degradation.

1328:v2:c7628c5f8192.title: Reload MCP servers and skills after project change in picker
1328:v2:c7628c5f8192.summary: This PR updates the CLI so that when a developer switches projects through the project picker, the agent/MCP and skill registries are reinitialized for the newly selected project directory. Previously, `initializeAgentRegistry` and `initializeSkillRegistry` were not called after `setProjectRoot`, leaving cached local agents, MCP servers, and skills stale from the previous project and causing features like custom skills and MCP-based tools to fail to load. The fix clears the cached agent mode map and agents directory before reloading definitions, and adds an integration test reproducing the original bug and verifying correct reloads across project switches.

1308:v2:4c5239224ebf.title: Fix stuck model switches from false end-failure in session takeover
1308:v2:4c5239224ebf.summary: PR #1308 refactors the model_locked takeover path into runModelLockedTakeover with a new planModelLockedSwitch helper that distinguishes a real release from a lock that already released itself, so the "ending it failed" notice only fires after a genuine delete was attempted. The change adds full test coverage in model-locked-takeover.test.ts and freebuff-session-api.test.ts, and introduces a consume-once explicit-pick marker to bound retries to a single round.

1316:v2:8b479e8ef64f.title: Stop the CLI launcher from re-downloading an installed binary on every launch
1316:v2:8b479e8ef64f.summary: The launcher now skips re-downloading the platform binary when it already exists on disk, even if the `freebuff-metadata.json` cache is missing or corrupt. A new `getUpdateComparisonVersion` helper falls back to the wrapper version when the cached version is null, so genuine updates still proceed while lost-cache launches stop triggering a full release transfer. The registry URL is now overridable via `CODEBUFF_NPM_REGISTRY_URL`, mirroring the existing app URL escape hatch for tests.

1302:v2:b9eff978cd65.title: Expand response assertion test coverage
1302:v2:b9eff978cd65.summary: Adds test cases to the assertion suite in common/src/util/__tests__/axiom-complete-response.test.ts covering complete responses, statusless cases, and non-object inputs. Tightens the existing partial response assertion with anchored error regex. This broadens coverage of the Axiom response guard used by operator-facing telemetry integrations

1292:v2:061f63efbf47.title: Drop orphaned tool results at trim boundary
1292:v2:061f63efbf47.summary: Adds a post-trim pass to trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit that removes tool messages whose matching assistant tool-call was cut at the token-limit boundary, preventing providers from rejecting the result with a missing tool_call_id error. It compares tool-call ids present in the input against those surviving the trim and drops only the orphaned results, leaving any pre-existing malformations untouched.

1274:v2:df08f0d72238.title: Feat(cli): scroll the transcript three lines per wheel notch
1274:v2:df08f0d72238.summary: The PR proposes adding a `wheelScrollAcceleration` utility to the CLI's chat transcript scrollbox, replacing OpenTUI's default single-line scroll with a flat three lines per wheel notch. It introduces a `ConstantScrollAccel` class that returns a fixed multiplier of 3, ignoring scroll velocity unlike `MacOSScrollAccel`, and includes unit and integration tests verifying the behavior. The change addresses user feedback that the transcript scrolls too slowly, matching terminal and desktop app conventions.

1258:v2:c5e74a5f9efe.title: Wait for current turn to finish before auto-update restart
1258:v2:c5e74a5f9efe.summary: The npm-wrapper launcher now polls a per-pid run-activity marker file written by the CLI while an agent turn is in progress, deferring `stopRunningProcess` for the auto-update restart until that marker clears (bounded by `RUN_IDLE_MAX_WAIT_MS`). A new `startRunActivityMarker` subscribes to `isChainInProgress` transitions in `chat-store` and creates/removes the `codebuff-run-active-${pid}` file accordingly, while `spawnInstalledBinary` clears any stale marker left by a process that died before its own exit handler ran. Tests cover immediate resolution when idle, bounded waiting on an active turn, stale-marker cleanup, and ordering of staging, waiting, and stopping.

1256:v2:e0c40e49f4a5.title: Queue /plan, /interview, /review mid-turn instead of interrupting
1256:v2:e0c40e49f4a5.summary: The PR routes /plan, /interview, and /review submissions (and their inline-argument forms) through a new sendOrQueuePrompt helper in command-registry.ts, so that when a run is already in progress the input is appended to the pending queue rather than firing a second sendMessage that would register a competing active-run owner. It also introduces capturePendingAttachments and clears pending attachments in the test setup/teardown, ensuring staged attachments follow the prompt they were staged for whether the send is immediate or queued.

1265:v2:14bc15498869.title: Register compact command in slash commands palette and registry
1265:v2:14bc15498869.summary: The PR adds a new `compact` slash command (with `summarize` alias) to the `cli` that surfaces in the slash commands palette via `slash-commands.ts` and is registered in `command-registry.ts` with a handler in `compact.ts`. The command compacts and summarizes conversation history, bailing early if the conversation is empty, queuing the command if a stream or chain is active, and dispatching `/compact` to the agent runtime otherwise. A new test suite in `compact-command.test.ts` covers early bail, idle dispatch, and queueing behavior.

1270:v2:35e1f28fa310.title: Fix NaN/Infinity handling in ad display count
1270:v2:35e1f28fa310.summary: The PR updates `responseAdDisplayCount` in `common/src/util/lazy-response-ads.ts` to guard against non-finite inputs by substituting them with zero before applying `Math.max` and `Math.floor`. It adds a new test file covering clamping behavior for NaN, Infinity, and negative inputs, plus flooring of fractional values.

1284:v2:f3da456b874b.title: Fix NaN handling in ttft bucket index
1284:v2:f3da456b874b.summary: The PR corrects the ttft bucket index calculation so that NaN ttft values default to bucket 0 instead of propagating as NaN, while leaving the existing clamping behavior for Infinity unchanged. A corresponding test case is added to lock in the NaN-to-0 routing and verify that positive Infinity still clamps to the top bucket and negative Infinity lands in bucket 0.

1261:v2:04ed29339961.title: Clamp negative streaks to zero before computing tier bonuses
1261:v2:04ed29339961.summary: The getFreebuffStreakGlmWeeklyUnits function now applies Math.max(0, streak) before dividing by FREEBUFF_STREAK_REWARD_INTERVAL_DAYS, so corrupted or malformed negative streak data yields zero bonus units instead of negative tiers. A new test case confirms negative inputs return zero while zero and positive values remain unchanged.

1260:v2:2933738e5296.title: Optimize streak calculation to single-pass iteration
1260:v2:2933738e5296.summary: The PR rewrites the streak calculation function in freebuff-streak.ts to replace the separate filter and reduce passes with a single for...of loop that builds the usageDateSet and tracks lastUsageDate together. This collapses two traversals of usageDates into one, trimming the diff to nine additions and seven removals while preserving the existing streak math. The change is a pure refactor with no behavioral impact.

1253:v2:fddbffabeff1.title: Guard non-finite input in usage summary window calculation
1253:v2:fddbffabeff1.summary: The `buildFreebuffUsageSummary` function now checks that `params.windowDays` is finite before falling back to `FREEBUFF_USAGE_MAP_DAYS`. A `NaN` or `Infinity` value previously flowed into `Math.max(1, ...)`, producing a misleading usage window and an invalid date-keyed set. This adds an explicit finite check so malformed input resolves to the default map days.

1250:v2:8e7fa6b1d1ac.title: Fix size validation in sample size with seed
1250:v2:8e7fa6b1d1ac.summary: The random sampling utility in common util random ts now clamps the size argument to a non-negative finite integer via safeSize before slicing the shuffled array. Previously a non-finite or negative size could produce a slice that returned the full array or threw. The change routes the validated safeSize into result slice instead of the raw size.

1248:v2:5c53c82e5f26.title: Fix NaN handling in streak display function
1248:v2:5c53c82e5f26.summary: The PR guards against non-finite `streak` values in `getFreebuffStreakLine` by substituting a `safeStreak` of 0 when `Number.isFinite(streak)` returns false. The sanitized value flows through the existing `filled`/`beyond`/`label` calculations so a NaN streak no longer corrupts the rendered streak row or produces invalid labels. It touches only `common/src/util/freebuff-streak-line.ts`.

1179:v2:c2d62ac12492.title: Reload MCP config after project selection
1179:v2:c2d62ac12492.summary: The PR adds an activateProject helper in cli/src/utils/project-picker.ts that switches the working directory, updates the project root, and reloads the local agent registry so .agents definitions and mcp.json servers are picked up from the newly selected project. The project picker callback in cli/src/index.tsx now calls activateProject instead of doing process.chdir plus setProjectRoot inline, and passes reloadAgentRegistry set to the inverse of hasAgentOverride so an explicit --agent override still preserves the caller-provided registry. A reloadLocalAgentRegistry function is introduced in cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts to clear the cached agent lists and directory before reinitializing.

1244:v2:fce85fb59a75.title: Tighten date validation to reject Infinity values
1244:v2:fce85fb59a75.summary: The daysBetween function in reddit-freebuff-retention.ts now uses Number.isFinite instead of Number.isNaN to validate date inputs. This change correctly rejects Infinity values that would otherwise pass through the previous NaN-only check, ensuring invalid date ranges throw an error instead of producing incorrect calculations.

1291:v2:1cf063f16e1e.title: Guard whitespace-only old strings against empty-match corruption
1291:v2:1cf063f16e1e.summary: The PR adds a guard in `tryMatchOldStr` so that an `oldString` composed entirely of whitespace is reported as not-found rather than collapsing to an empty search string that vacuously matches at position zero.

1243:v2:bf9573334ab6.title: Fix NaN handling in ad slot selection
1243:v2:bf9573334ab6.summary: The `getResponseAdForSlot` function in `common/src/util/lazy-response-ads.ts` now validates `slotIndex` with `Number.isFinite()`, defaulting to 0 when the value is NaN or Infinity. Previously, a NaN `slotIndex` would propagate through `Math.floor`, `Math.max`, and the modulo operation, yielding NaN and returning an undefined ad. This change ensures robust ad slot selection under invalid inputs.

1242:v2:ed30d75523d2.title: Fix NaN handling in file read offset and limit
1242:v2:ed30d75523d2.summary: The PR adds Number.isFinite() checks in the windowFileRead function within common/src/util/file-read-limits.ts. Previously, NaN or Infinity values for offset and limit could propagate through Math.floor and Math.max, producing unintended NaN results. The fix defaults to safe values when the inputs are invalid.

1241:v2:ff7d6ee8a357.title: Fix NaN handling in plan units formatting
1241:v2:ff7d6ee8a357.summary: The plan units formatter returns the string 'NaN' when the units argument is NaN or Infinity because it lacks a finite-number guard. The PR adds a `Number.isFinite()` check at the start of the function in `common/src/util/freebuff-plan-summary.ts` to return '0' for invalid inputs before the rounding logic runs. No existing tests cover this function.

1240:v2:466b38676f37.title: Fix NaN handling in pct function in db-health-alerts
1240:v2:466b38676f37.summary: The pct function in common/src/util/db-health-alerts.ts now validates that part and whole are finite numbers using Number.isFinite() before performing the percentage calculation. Previously, NaN or Infinity inputs would propagate as NaN through Math.round((part / whole) * 100), potentially causing incorrect alert evaluation. The fix returns 0 for any invalid or non-positive inputs, ensuring the evaluateStatCoverage function produces reliable results even with malformed database health data.

1238:v2:3290d6ed9dab.title: Fix NaN handling in ttft bucket index
1238:v2:3290d6ed9dab.summary: The PR proposes adding a Number.isFinite() check in the ttftBucketIndex function in common/src/util/ttft-histogram.ts, defaulting invalid inputs like NaN or Infinity to 0 to prevent the calculation from producing NaN values. This avoids a chain of NaN propagation through Math.max and Math.log. The change touches only the common package, an approved contribution area.

1235:v2:3346a2c810c0.title: Replace global NaN check with safer alternative in XML parser
1235:v2:3346a2c810c0.summary: This PR updates the `parseEntities` function in `common/src/util/saxy.ts` to use `Number.isNaN` instead of the global `isNaN`, avoiding unwanted type coercion when validating parsed numeric entity values. The change improves type safety in the XML entity parsing logic.

1236:v2:5907c053ea71.title: Improve type safety in dates utility number check
1236:v2:5907c053ea71.summary: This pull request updates the `formatTimeUntil` function in `common/src/util/dates.ts` to replace the global `isNaN` function with `Number.isNaN`, avoiding implicit type coercion that can produce unexpected results when validating the computed time difference value. The change improves type safety and predictability in time formatting logic without altering the overall behavior for valid inputs.

1222:v2:b1e6ce90764a.title: Add shallow equality guards to MessageBlockStore
1222:v2:b1e6ce90764a.summary: The PR adds shallow equality guards to `setContext` and `setCallbacks` in the MessageBlockStore to prevent unnecessary re-renders caused by Zustand notifying subscribers with new object references even when values are identical. It also exports a shared `EMPTY_RESPONSE_ADS` constant to maintain stable object reference identity when ads are disabled, and adds a unit test suite verifying that subscribers fire only on true mutations and are suppressed on identical updates.

1226:v2:4c4af0a0bd89.title: Bound file matches in suggestion engine, cut fuzzy allocations
1226:v2:4c4af0a0bd89.summary: The PR caps file suggestion results to the top 100 ranked matches in `filterFileMatches`, preventing memory spikes and keystroke lag when typing `@` mentions in large projects. It rewrites `createHighlightIndices` to populate index arrays in a single direct loop, and swaps `indices.filter(...).length` in `fuzzyMatch` for an in-place counter loop to avoid throwaway array allocations.

1223:v2:f087c20d011f.title: Fast bailout for indentation retry in diff matching
1223:v2:f087c20d011f.summary: The PR refactors `tryToDoStringReplacementWithExtraIndentation` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` to pre-split `searchContent` into `searchLines` once and bail out early when the first indented line is absent from `oldFileContent`, avoiding up to 18 redundant split/map/join cycles. It also lazily splits `replaceContent` only on a match and adds unit tests covering first-line mismatch and leading empty lines. On a 50-line benchmark the failed-indentation recovery path drops from 96.10 ms to 6.49 ms (14.8x faster).

1217:v2:09876e06a681.title: Eliminate redundant stat calls and queue shifts in file tree crawl
1217:v2:09876e06a681.summary: This PR reorders the directory traversal in `project-file-tree.ts` so that `fs.readdir` runs before `parseGitignore`, calling `parseGitignore` only when an ignore file appears in the returned entries. It also swaps `queue.shift()!` for an index pointer to avoid quadratic array reallocations and passes existing directory entries into `parseGitignoreWithMode` to skip unnecessary stat calls.

1219:v2:49438e90c74a.title: Optimize think tag parser with early-exit and cursor indexing
1219:v2:49438e90c74a.summary: The PR refactors the think-tag detection logic in `cli/src/utils/think-tag-parser.ts` to replace sequential prefix array checks with an early-exit `lastIndexOf` approach and switches `parseThinkTags` from repeated string slicing to index cursor traversal, reducing allocations. The unused `PARTIAL_OPEN_PREFIXES` and `PARTIAL_CLOSE_PREFIXES` arrays are removed, and all 22 existing unit tests pass with identical behavior.

1218:v2:580edcff23fc.title: Conditionally compute visual line layout in Thinking component
1218:v2:580edcff23fc.summary: In `cli/src/components/thinking.tsx`, the `getLastNVisualLines` wrapping computation now runs only when `thinkingCollapseState` is `'preview'`, skipping the expensive measure-and-wrap pass for both `'hidden'` and `'expanded'` states. In `cli/src/components/blocks/thinking-block.tsx`, a fast-path avoids allocating intermediate `.map()` arrays when `blocks.length === 1` during streaming updates. The PR adds unit tests covering all three collapse states and reports 5x speedups on hidden state and 4.3x on expanded state in end-to-end React render benchmarks.

1215:v2:5b5ebb50e8b6.title: Optimize value extraction with early guard and streaming scan
1215:v2:5b5ebb50e8b6.summary: This PR refactors the value extraction helper in the CLI utilities to avoid allocating a full array of lines on every call by replacing the split operation with an index-based line scanner that walks the output incrementally. An instant substring guard checks for the presence of the searched key before any parsing begins, and keys located near the start of the output now return immediately without scanning the remainder. Benchmarks show lookups for missing keys in a 5,000-line output dropping from 11.02ms down to 0.20ms (55x speedup), and finding a key on line 1 dropping from 17.41ms down to 0.31ms (56x speedup across 100 runs).

1212:v2:8ce7a100f5d7.title: Support Windows paths and directory separators in path tab completion
1212:v2:8ce7a100f5d7.summary: The PR refactors path tab completion in the CLI to recognize Windows drive paths (C:\...) and UNC paths as absolute by exporting an isAbsolutePath helper that checks both POSIX and Windows path styles. It also exports isCompleteDirectory to detect trailing backslashes appended by path-completion.ts, and toRelativePath to convert absolute completions back to relative display paths, restoring automatic directory navigation on Windows.

1208:v2:b302df72779e.title: Auto-save launched project to recent projects and canonicalize paths
1208:v2:b302df72779e.summary: This PR proposes automatically recording a launched project into recent-projects.json during CLI boot in cli/src/index.tsx whenever Freebuff starts directly inside a project rather than showing the project picker, filling the gap left by saveRecentProject previously being called only on project-picker selection. It canonicalizes projectPath with path.resolve() in saveRecentProject and removeRecentProject within cli/src/utils/recent-projects.ts to prevent duplicate entries and filtering mismatches from relative paths or trailing slashes, and switches the import of getConfigDir from ./auth to ./config-dir to avoid loading the full auth/api stack. New tests in cli/src/__tests__/utils/recent-projects.test.ts cover path canonicalization, disk-validation filtering, LRU-style capping at MAX_RECENT_PROJECTS, project removal, and clearing behavior.

1206:v2:e139a3509eac.title: Support quoted image paths and preserve prompt in CLI image command
1206:v2:e139a3509eac.summary: This PR refactors the `/image <path> [message]` command parsing to correctly handle quoted paths (`"..."` and `'...'`) and backslash-escaped spaces by extracting the logic into a standalone pure utility `parseImageCommandArgs`. Previously, naive whitespace splitting corrupted filenames containing spaces and discarded the accompanying user message. The parser now preserves the attached image alongside the extracted prompt message so it remains visible in the input field.

1207:v2:f9ae54004122.title: Direct launcher crash reports to product issues tracker
1207:v2:f9ae54004122.summary: The PR updates `printCrashDiagnostics` in `cli/release-core/launcher.js` to build the crash report issue tracker URL from the `packageName` configuration value rather than hardcoding `CodebuffAI/codebuff`. A new regression test in `cli/src/__tests__/release/wrapper-safety.test.ts` verifies that crash diagnostics emit the product-specific GitHub issues URL for both `freebuff` and `codebuff` launchers.

1202:v2:b0163bb8f148.title: Fix dead agents-graveyard test imports in agent-runtime
1202:v2:b0163bb8f148.summary: This PR fixes two TypeScript compilation errors in the agent-runtime package caused by imports from the archived agents-graveyard directory. It replaces the dead imports in read-docs-tool.test.ts and web-search-tool.test.ts with active public definitions from agents/researcher/researcher-docs.ts and agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts respectively. 1205:v2:ff6788369871.title: Support Freebuff binary and environment variable in tmux test helper

1201:v2:925150efc2d0.title: Fix Zod v4 schema description crash in agent-runtime
1201:v2:925150efc2d0.summary: This PR guards the `schema.description` getter access inside `ensureJsonSchemaCompatible()` in both `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/prompts.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/prompts.ts` within a nested try/catch block. The fix ensures these schemas return the passthrough fallback object cleanly without throwing.

1204:v2:0a6670cf3e25.title: Fix Pino type imports and destination in evals logger
1204:v2:0a6670cf3e25.summary: The PR updates `evals/logger.ts` to import `pino` as the default export and `LogFn` as a top-level type from `pino`, resolving three `tsc` typechecking errors that occurred because Pino v9 moved `pino.destination` onto the default export and exposed `LogFn` as a named type. 1203:v2:1fae6417267d.title: Fix CLI test runner preload and test-utils fallback for public mirror
1203:v2:1fae6417267d.summary: The PR removes the non-existent ../test/setup-scm-loader.ts entry from cli/bunfig.toml preload, which prevented bun test from starting in cli due to a missing file after the root test directory was unbundled from the public mirror. It also wraps the dynamic require for packages/internal/src/env in a try/catch that falls back to TEST_CLIENT_ENV_DEFAULTS and TEST_SERVER_ENV_DEFAULTS when the private internal module is unavailable in the public repo, allowing ensureCliTestEnv to initialize without crashing. These changes unblock CLI testing on the public mirror where private modules are not included.

1195:v2:83f7d1c575b5.title: Recover agent context from torn run-state.json backups
1195:v2:83f7d1c575b5.summary: When `run-state.json` is unreadable, `loadMostRecentChatState` now recovers from the rotated `.bak` or leftover checkpoint `.tmp` files, ordered newest-first by mtime with path-based tiebreaks for deterministic selection. `loadMostRecentChatState` returns a `runStateRestored` flag so the resume flow surfaces the loss instead of silently answering amnesiacally, and `clearChatState` now also removes the `.bak` so deleting a chat leaves no recoverable state behind. 1194:v2:97d57319356b.title: Fix critical bugs in string truncation and context window lookup
1194:v2:97d57319356b.summary: This PR fixes two critical bugs. In `agents/base-chat.ts`, the context window lookup is changed from `CONTEXT_WINDOWS[model ?? '']` to `(model && CONTEXT_WINDOWS[model]) ?? DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW`, avoiding an unnecessary lookup when `model` is undefined. In `common/src/util/string.ts`, `truncateStringWithMessage` is updated to use `Math.max(0, ...)` guards for `maxLength` minus `suffix.length`, `maxLength` minus `prefix.length`, and `Math.floor((maxLength - middle.length) / 2)`, preventing negative slice indices when `maxLength` is smaller than the message length.

1191:v2:51a6bad38c6c.title: Add tests and type safety for array utilities
1191:v2:51a6bad38c6c.summary: The PR introduces a new test file `common/src/util/array.test.ts` with 28 tests covering `filterDefined`, `buildArray`, and `groupConsecutive`, and fixes a loose `any[]` return type in `groupConsecutive` by adding a `Group` type definition in `common/src/util/array.ts`, improving type safety for consumers.

1170:v2:bfe68636735f.title: Break 3-file import cycle in cli/project-files
1170:v2:bfe68636735f.summary: The PR redirects the import of `getConfigDir` from `auth.ts` to `config-dir.ts` in `project-files.ts`, breaking a circular chain where `project-files.ts` depended on `auth.ts`, which imported `logger.ts`, which then re-imported back into `project-files.ts`. Since `auth.ts` merely re-exports the same `getConfigDir` from `config-dir.ts`, the swap preserves identical behavior while removing the runtime risk of `undefined` values at module load time, and adds two tests in `project-files-chat-id.test.ts` to assert `getProjectDataDir` resolves via the direct path.

1177:v2:13bb17fd2e39.title: Synchronize terminal cursor with input caret for CJK IME support
1177:v2:13bb17fd2e39.summary: This PR proposes moving the real terminal hardware cursor to match the MultilineInput visual caret, using string-width to compute CJK cell offsets alongside tab expansion, wrapped visual lines, viewport offsets, and vertical scrolling. It centralizes OpenTUI 0.3.4 TextBufferView.lineInfo access behind a guarded adapter, keeps the line-info-change subscription stable, and hides the hardware cursor when the input loses focus or unmounts while preserving the existing visual cursor behavior. The approach is validated with regression tests covering ASCII, CJK, mixed widths, tabs, wrapped lines, viewport and scroll offsets, and renderer-level cursor placement on wrapped rows.

1176:v2:afaa31defbf1.title: Never wipe chat history on compaction
1176:v2:afaa31defbf1.summary: The compaction path now only replaces history when a real summary is produced, keeping existing turns on empty or think-only responses and logging a warning. Summary identity moves from content matching to a `CONVERSATION_SUMMARY` tag, with a legacy full-envelope fallback for pre-tag summaries. Regression tests cover both the empty response and the quoting user message cases.

1174:v2:825474ddcee2.title: Recover mid-stream 5xx/429 like severed connections
1174:v2:825474ddcee2.summary: The PR extends classifyThrownStreamRecovery so that provider-reported 500/429 arriving mid-stream via the openai-compatible shim take the same capped retry path as a severed body, injecting a status-naming note instead of ending the run. Client errors (400/401/402/403) stay fatal, and post-cancel 5xx stays fatal, with regression tests added in sdk/src/__tests__/stream-interruption.test.ts. This flips the previous logic where socket-level errors were recoverable and provider failures were fatal.

1175:v2:7d3ddfdc5da9.title: Fix(sdk): take max of OpenRouter cost and upstream inference cost
1175:v2:7d3ddfdc5da9.summary: The PR switches all three cost-reporting sites in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` (streaming `reportCost`, `generateText`, and structured paths) to take the max of `usage.cost` and `cost_details.upstream_inference_cost` instead of summing them, preventing double-counted credits on normal OpenRouter routes and correctly handling BYOK routes where cost is zero. It adds a regression test asserting exact credits for `cost=0.01, upstream=0.02` (failing under the sum with 3 vs 2) and validates with `bun test` and `tsc --noEmit`.

1234:v2:8923546885c4.title: Switch to type-safe NaN check in log ingestion utility
1234:v2:8923546885c4.summary: This PR updates the log ingestion utility to use `Number.isNaN` instead of the global `isNaN` function for timestamp validation. The global `isNaN` coerces values to numbers first, which can cause false positives, while `Number.isNaN` only matches actual NaN values of the number type. The change improves type safety in `common/src/util/log-ingest.ts`.

1220:v2:b8d78a81080a.title: Bound last-N visual lines memory growth
1220:v2:b8d78a81080a.summary: The terminal text helper that gathers the final n visual lines now drops the oldest line as soon as the buffer fills, marking `hasMore = true`, instead of keeping every wrapped line and slicing afterward. This keeps memory for long reasoning blocks, assistant messages, and terminal logs strictly bounded to O(n) with no extra allocation. Unit tests cover empty inputs, small counts, wrapping edges, and multi-hundred line buffers.

1213:v2:4d2c25047968.title: Support relative and absolute path keys in file windows lookup
1213:v2:4d2c25047968.summary: The file windows lookup in `getFiles` now checks `filePath`, `relativePath`, and `fullPath` instead of only `filePath`. This prevents the lookup from returning `undefined` when the requested path format differs from the key format, which previously caused the whole file to be dumped from line 1. Regression tests cover dot-slash, relative, and absolute path combinations.

1214:v2:9b9b116794df.title: Speed up CLI path completion by skipping stat calls and matching prefix first
1214:v2:9b9b116794df.summary: The PR rewrites getPathCompletion in the CLI to call readdirSync with { withFileTypes: true } and moves the prefix match check before any filesystem stat calls, so most tab completions require zero statSync syscalls. It only falls back to statSync when a matched entry is a symbolic link that needs directory resolution, cutting completion latency roughly 6.2x in a 2,500 file directory. A new regression test confirms symlinked directories still resolve and complete correctly.

1200:v2:271a643a3f66.title: Add missing CLI dev dependencies for typechecking
1200:v2:271a643a3f66.summary: The PR adds @types/react-dom, tar, and @types/tar to the cli package.json devDependencies to resolve 10 TypeScript compilation errors that occur when running typecheck or tests against the CLI package. These additions align the cli package with the root package.json React 19 overrides and match the dependencies already declared in cli/release/package.json for the tar module.

1196:v2:78806bfb7643.title: Explain why the file reader blocks files matched by ignore rules
1196:v2:78806bfb7643.summary: The file reader tool returns a bare sentinel value for files excluded by ignore rules such as gitignore, codebuffignore, or built-in defaults, leaving the agent unable to tell the user why a file is unreadable or even confirm its existence. This change appends a trailing reason and remediation hint to the existing sentinel prefix on the ignore-rule block path, following the existing too-large precedent, while keeping the environment-policy and internal-edit paths opaque for secrets.

1395:v2:4ba438df451d.title: Fix BuffBench terminal crashes with numeric env values
1395:v2:4ba438df451d.summary: BuffBench configurations may include numeric env values such as PORT 3003, and the SDK calls .trim() when scrubbing credentials, which causes terminal commands to crash before starting. The change converts env values to strings before passing them to the SDK, and the author verified that printenv PORT succeeds with credential scrubbing enabled.

1409:v2:7a7d4f668d17.title: Guard ad slot count against NaN and Infinity inputs
1409:v2:7a7d4f668d17.summary: The PR adds Number.isFinite checks for nodeCount, step, and firstAdAfterNodes so non-finite values fall back to safe defaults instead of propagating NaN through the floor calculation. 1458:v2:921780925ae5.title: Make public data-use copy test pass in public mirror
1458:v2:921780925ae5.summary: The PR adjusts the test file `common/src/__tests__/freebuff-public-data-use-copy.test.ts` to handle two issues specific to the public export of the private source tree. 1459:v2:6adef34b4420.summary: The PR converts three tests in the 'canonical root prompt openings match their source definitions' block that currently fail with ENOENT into tests skipped via `test.skipIf(!isInThisTree(...))`, because the files they read ('freebuff/web/convex/coding_agent/cli_agent/freebuff_bundled_agents.ts', 'freebuff-desktop/src/server/harness/thread-agent.ts', and 'freebuff-desktop/src/shared/mission-prompt.ts') are part of the private source tree but not shipped in the public export. 1470:v2:fcd8e40fb6ab.title: Guard CLI exit save against stale checkpoint writes
1470:v2:fcd8e40fb6ab.summary: This change prevents an older in-flight checkpoint from overwriting the final state saved during CLI shutdown. 1473:v2:82e1e8df9148.summary: The change proposes to replace folder-name-based chat storage with SHA-256 hashes of the absolute project path, ensuring that separate projects with the same directory name do not share or overwrite saved chats and run state. 1459:v2:a62e4cf72dc0.title: Skip agent tests when source files are missing
1459:v2:a62e4cf72dc0.summary: The PR updates the free agents test file to add a helper that checks whether source files exist in the current directory. 1458:v2:56b96e970902.title: Fix public data use copy tests by normalizing lines and skipping
1458:v2:56b96e970902.summary: This update modifies the data use copy test suite to handle a public mirror export that lacks certain private source files. Additionally, a new file attributes config pins the modified files to Unix line endings to stabilize checkout behavior.

1477:v2:35de15a7aeef.title: Accept an initial prompt argument in the freebuff CLI
1477:v2:35de15a7aeef.summary: The PR proposes adding positional prompt argument parsing to the freebuff CLI command so that a task string like freebuff "add a dark mode toggle" is captured into an `initialPrompt` value, mirroring how codebuff handles it. 1477:v2:ab500468cbf9.title: Freebuff CLI takes an initial prompt argument

The README gains an example usage block.

1518:v2:7d9fa0a84089.title: Harden release URL and redirect validation

1519:v2:3378f9de4b37.title: Prevent follow-up cards from interrupting Freebuff base2 runs

The change preserves the ask_user tool for clarifying questions and allows explicit overrides to re-enable follow-up cards.

1520:v2:64014193f61e.title: Align shared JSON types with readonly values
1520:v2:64014193f61e.summary: The PR proposes aligning the shared JSON value and array types with the AI SDK by applying readonly constraints to prevent TypeScript errors during SDK declaration bundling. 1519:v2:36b1f59486b7.title: Prevent optional follow-ups from pausing free runs
1519:v2:36b1f59486b7.summary: The PR disables the optional follow-up tool by default for Freebuff base2 roots while keeping the ability to ask clarifying questions. 1520:v2:a166709d7dd4.title: Align shared JSON types with AI SDK readonly values

1518:v2:c99b071d4f12.title: Harden release download and redirect checks
1518:v2:c99b071d4f12.summary: The proposal tightens validation of release download origins to reject overrides containing a path or a nonstandard port on public release hosts, while still allowing custom ports for loopback addresses used in local development. 1316:v2:872334be3b7e.title: Prevent redundant binary downloads when launcher metadata is missing
1316:v2:872334be3b7e.summary: This change stops the launcher from re-downloading the platform binary on every launch when the metadata cache file is missing or unreadable. It checks for the installed binary's presence and falls back to the wrapper version to determine if an update is truly required, preventing unnecessary downloads and startup failures when the release host is unreachable.

1546:v2:a086d9fd612f.title: Block URL tool when network proxy is active
1546:v2:a086d9fd612f.summary: The update changes the web URL tooling in the SDK so that it refuses to operate when system proxy environment variables are set. This ensures that the destination server cannot be spoofed by a malicious proxy resolving hostnames to private or internal addresses.

1545:v2:20a1cc0f8d48.title: Sponsored refusal walk fails closed on inline code and variable
1545:v2:20a1cc0f8d48.summary: The sponsored refusal walk now returns unverifiable for interpreter inline code flags like `node -e` and `python -c`, which previously passed unread. 1545:v2:c8068a3aa364.title: Refuse variable commands and inline interpreter code
1545:v2:c8068a3aa364.summary: The PR proposes failing closed on command words built from shell variables or substitutions in the sponsored refusal walk. It also classifies interpreter inline code flags, such as the short forms of `node --eval` and `python --command`, as unverifiable instead of passing them through. The change adds tests to confirm these bypass spellings are now refused while script files and judged modules remain allowed.

1546:v2:e693e344e887.title: Refuse url fetch when proxy is active
1546:v2:e693e344e887.summary: This change prevents a security bypass in the `read_url` tool where the system would fall back to global fetch when running under Bun with proxy variables configured. Instead of dropping DNS pinning and risking server-side request forgery, the transport now refuses the request and returns a clear error explaining why the destination cannot be validated. A new test case confirms that the tool rejects requests when proxy environment variables are present.

1551:v2:448552d9dfde.title: Fix stale React props corrupting text during IME batched input
1551:v2:448552d9dfde.summary: This PR refactors eight keyboard and mouse handlers in the CLI's multiline input component to read state from synchronous refs instead of React props. This change ensures that when input methods compose multiple events in a single batch, each handler sees the latest text and cursor position without stale data. New unit tests verify correct behavior for Vietnamese IME compose-and-replace scenarios where backspace and accent insertion occur together.

1551:v2:ec95e06ab72e.title: Fix stale React props corrupting IME input in multiline editor
1551:v2:ec95e06ab72e.summary: The PR proposes switching all keyboard and mouse handlers in the `MultilineInput` component to read from synchronous refs instead of React props. This ensures that batched Input Method Editor events, such as those from Vietnamese IMEs, see the latest state updates. The changes are complemented by new tests that verify correct behavior during complex character replacement sequences.

1551:v2:005aa857d519.title: Multiline input now uses synchronous refs for batched key events
1551:v2:005aa857d519.summary: This PR updates the remaining keyboard handlers in MultilineInput to read text and cursor state from synchronous refs instead of potentially stale React props, and to write those refs before calling onChange. The change extends the ref-based pattern already applied to text insertion so that deletion, navigation, cursor movement, and mouse interactions remain correct when multiple key events arrive within a single React batch.

1551:v2:9f113d58cad2.title: Fix text corruption during batched keyboard input
1551:v2:9f113d58cad2.summary: This change updates all keyboard handlers in the `MultilineInput` component to read state from synchronous refs instead of React props and to update those refs before calling `onChange`. The associated tests simulate these batched input scenarios to verify that ref-based reads prevent the corruption.

1551:v2:558f3e4b713d.title: Fix stale props corrupting IME input in text field
1551:v2:558f3e4b713d.summary: This pull request modifies the multiline text input component so that all keyboard handlers read current values from internal references instead of outdated props. It also updates tests to drive rapid key sequences through real handlers to prevent text corruption during batched input events.

1553:v2:080dc3a76f3f.title: Skip plugin hook and vendor directories in local agent loader
1553:v2:080dc3a76f3f.summary: This update modifies the local agent loading functions to ignore `hooks/` and `vendor/` subdirectories inside `.agents`, preventing third-party plugin support scripts from being imported as executable modules. The change stops the CLI from crashing at startup when a plugin hook script calls `process.exit`, ensuring the user interface initializes correctly. Regression tests are included to verify that files in these skipped directories do not execute side effects during the discovery process.

1554:v2:8ba06aacf46a.title: Add foreground freebuff update command
1554:v2:8ba06aacf46a.summary: This PR introduces a new `update` command that triggers an immediate release installation in the foreground, bypassing the deferred update mechanism used during normal session exits. The npm launcher's `main` function now checks for this command before spawning the binary, allowing it to reuse the existing staging and atomic installation paths while ensuring no running process holds the replaced files. If the command is invoked directly on the binary without the npm wrapper, the CLI will exit and instruct the user to use npm instead.

1554:v2:ee3964bf05ab.title: Add foreground update command to install latest release immediately
1554:v2:ee3964bf05ab.summary: This PR adds a new update subcommand that triggers the launcher to fetch, verify, and install the latest binary before the main process starts. It updates the argument parser to recognize the new command and adds a fallback message in the binary entry point to guide users who bypassed the npm wrapper. The change also includes tests covering command detection, version comparison, and installation failure handling.

1553:v2:e950ef234188.title: Skip plugin hook and vendor directories in agent loader
1553:v2:e950ef234188.summary: This PR proposes adding `hooks/` and `vendor/` to the list of skipped subdirectories in `loadLocalAgents` and `listLocalAgentFiles`. 1554:v2:26377f4a4e23.title: Foreground update command for Freebuff
1554:v2:26377f4a4e23.summary: This PR proposes a new update command in the launcher that downloads and installs the latest release synchronously, reusing existing staging and atomic-install logic. 1555:v2:d039c957c16a.title: Add a side question command for quick answers in the CLI

1553:v2:427a807e04f7.title: Skip plugin hook and vendor directories during local agent loading

1555:v2:d77ba9367e96.title: Add a /btw command to ask a side question without affecting
1555:v2:d77ba9367e96.summary: The pull request introduces a new slash command that sends a question to a single, tool-less agent built from the freebuff model catalog. 1286:v2:6cde9d6755d9.title: Add missing SCm loader preload
1286:v2:6cde9d6755d9.summary: This PR introduces a bun plugin that loads SCM files as strings to resolve import failures in CLI tests. It also adds a regression test to verify that tree-sitter query files load correctly.

1560:v2:0722e3e9f983.title: Preserve custom pinned thread ordering in panel model
1560:v2:0722e3e9f983.summary: The PR introduces an optional `pinnedOrder` property to `arrangeThreadPanel` that allows viewer-defined ordering for pinned threads, overriding the default newest-first sort while preserving unarranged items in a stable fallback position. 1560:v2:03dcb7344915.title: Let users keep pinned threads in a chosen order

1712:v2:c058bff9cbe8.title: One-command VPS deployment for the opencode hub project

1723:v2:437b440f7fd0.title: Keep completed responses when compressed stream errors
1723:v2:437b440f7fd0.summary: The proposal adds a completion guard to the OpenAI-compatible chat converter so that a decompression error after the model has sent its final status and token count does not abort the stream. 1588:v2:36e3ac90c329.title: Cache history message conversion and token estimates
1588:v2:36e3ac90c329.summary: The change introduces a `WeakMap` cache to ensure each history message is cloned, scrubbed, and schema-checked only once per process, replacing the previous quadratic full-history work on every agent step. It also memoizes per-message token counts with a separate probe mechanism to avoid caching stale estimates during iterative content clipping.

1712:v2:10fdeef031ff.title: Add VPS deployment and diagnostics for opencode hub
1712:v2:10fdeef031ff.summary: The PR introduces a Docker Compose stack with Caddy for deploying the opencode hub to a virtual private server with automatic HTTPS certificates. It includes a bootstrap script for one-command installation and a diagnostic script to inspect deployment health. 1723:v2:dcf6c2341ed9.title: Preserve chat responses after stream compression errors
1723:v2:dcf6c2341ed9.summary: This proposal introduces a helper function that detects when a chat provider stream has finished with a valid status and token usage before a compression error occurs. It allows the underlying stream to flush and close normally in that specific scenario instead of triggering a stream interruption, while preserving the abort behavior for incomplete responses. A new test using a local server verifies that complete answers retain their metadata despite an unfinished gzip trailer.

1712:v2:177eea3c57b0.title: Add VPS deployment and diagnostics for opencode hub
1712:v2:177eea3c57b0.summary: The PR proposes a complete deployment stack for `opencode-hub`, including Dockerfiles for the hub, data, opencode, and hermes services, along with a Caddy reverse proxy configuration for automated HTTPS. It introduces one-command installation scripts to deploy the stack to a fresh virtual private server and a diagnostic script to troubleshoot deployed instances.

1716:v2:a3a3692ae70a.title: Bypass quota gate for DeepSeek models in client metering
1716:v2:a3a3692ae70a.summary: The proposal amends `getFreebuffModelMeter` in `common/src/util/freebuff-session-pools.ts` to immediately return `{ canStart: true }` for any model ID starting with `deepseek/`, effectively skipping the quota and budget checks for that prefix. This change leaves all other model metering logic untouched and explicitly notes that server-side enforcement remains unaffected.

1725:v2:79e13706017b.title: Fix relative directory handling in SDK glob search
1725:v2:79e13706017b.summary: This change normalizes relative working directories in the SDK glob tool so that paths like "." or "src/../src" correctly match project files. It converts native path separators to forward slashes and treats the project root as a full scan when normalized to a dot.

1726:v2:ec4e61b70457.title: Add encrypted local secrets and local model runtime discovery
1726:v2:ec4e61b70457.summary: This pull request introduces two new CLI slash commands. The /local command probes Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and vLLM runtimes on loopback to list available models and save them as OpenAI-compatible BYOK connections for the agent. The /secrets command manages an AES-256-GCM encrypted vault where the model sees secret names but never values, with automatic substitution and redaction of sensitive data at the terminal command boundary. New source code in the common package handles discovery logic, vault encryption, and output scrubbing, while the SDK wires the secret boundary into terminal execution.

1728:v2:468e7e226acf.title: Report actual module errors in CLI test environment loader
1728:v2:468e7e226acf.summary: The CLI test environment loader currently masks specific module resolution errors as generic unknown errors because it only checks for the standard Error prototype. This PR introduces a helper function that extracts the error message from non-standard objects like Bun's ResolveMessage, ensuring the specific missing module path is included in the failure report. Three new tests verify that the detailed error message is preserved across different thrown value shapes.

1729:v2:668b6240dbb2.title: Upgrade lodash to 4.18.1 to clear two active security advisories
1729:v2:668b6240dbb2.summary: The PR proposes bumping the pinned `lodash` dependency from `4.17.23` to `4.18.1` in the root `package.json`, `common/package.json`, and `packages/agent-runtime/package.json`. It updates the corresponding lockfile entries to ensure the new version resolves correctly, addressing a high-severity code injection advisory and a moderate-severity prototype pollution advisory without altering any source code.

1730:v2:bff0d0408e13.title: Send release dispatches via fetch instead of shell curl
1730:v2:bff0d0408e13.summary: The PR proposes replacing the `execSync` curl commands in both CLI and SDK release scripts with direct `fetch` requests that keep the GitHub token in request headers. It also switches success detection from response body matching to HTTP status codes, preventing false success reports on 401 or 500 errors.

1730:v2:498f6980b7e7.title: Move release credential and version out of shell command line
1730:v2:498f6980b7e7.summary: The release scripts in `cli` and `sdk` used to build a shell command that embedded the GitHub token and the version argument directly in the process command line, where either could leak or be injected. This change replaces that with a fetch request object, keeping the token only in the `Authorization` header and serializing the version argument with `JSON.stringify`. It also stops relying on response body text to decide success, using the HTTP status code instead.

1723:v2:a4c46a7a51bf.title: Preserve finished streams when gzip or brotli errors occur
1723:v2:a4c46a7a51bf.summary: The change introduces a stream piping helper that allows a response converter to close cleanly if a decompression error happens after the finish status and token usage have been confirmed. It treats gzip and brotli failures in that specific state as non-critical, preventing valid completed responses from being discarded and retried.

1712:v2:8ba0bf316e02.title: Propose one-command virtual server deployment and diagnostics
1712:v2:8ba0bf316e02.summary: The PR adds a Docker Compose stack with Caddy that deploys the opencode hub to a virtual private server using automated HTTPS and a basic authentication layer. It includes one-command bootstrap and installation scripts that prepare the server, populate environment variables, and launch all containers, along with a read-only diagnostic script that checks DNS, ports, container status, and certificate validity. The change introduces separate server processes for the hub dashboard, a data registry, and the opencode agent, keeping internal services isolated from the public reverse proxy.

1726:v2:9c4ae51f8b39.title: Add local model detection and encrypted secret vault
1726:v2:9c4ae51f8b39.summary: The PR proposes new CLI slash commands to detect OpenAI-compatible runtimes on loopback and save them as connections so the agent can execute without a server. It also introduces a device-local encrypted vault that substitutes secret names with values only at the process boundary and redacts them from output. The changes span shared types, CLI handlers, and SDK tool execution.

1730:v2:6adb923ef7e5.title: Replace shell curl commands with fetch in release scripts
1730:v2:6adb923ef7e5.summary: This pull request rewrites the release workflow triggerers in `cli/scripts/release.ts` and `sdk/scripts/release.js` to construct request objects and use `fetch` instead of interpolating data into shell strings for `execSync`. It changes the success check to inspect the HTTP status code rather than searching the response text, preventing false success messages on authentication or server errors. New test files verify that the GitHub token remains in the memory space and that the version argument is safely encoded.

1729:v2:ca61e295424b.title: Update lodash version to 4.18.1
1729:v2:ca61e295424b.summary: The PR bumps the pinned lodash version from 4.17.23 to 4.18.1 in the root, common, and agent-runtime manifests, along with corresponding lockfile entries. This change addresses two security advisories, one for code injection via template imports and another for prototype pollution, while keeping exact version pins.

1725:v2:4d1fd3bc2c4b.title: Fix empty glob results for relative working directories
1725:v2:4d1fd3bc2c4b.summary: The pull request normalizes relative working directory inputs for file searches by converting native path separators and treating the project root dot path as the full directory tree. It adds a regression test that scans a temporary project to verify equivalent relative paths return the same file sets, fixing cases where raw string comparisons against raw paths caused zero results.

1728:v2:9d7d8f2df2d0.title: Report module resolution details in CLI environment load failures
1728:v2:9d7d8f2df2d0.summary: The PR introduces a helper function in the test utilities that extracts readable error details from various thrown objects, specifically handling Bun's module resolution errors that lack the standard error prototype. It replaces the generic unknown error fallback with the specific module path and resolution cause when the CLI environment loader fails. New tests verify that the error message names the missing module and remains actionable even when the thrown value has no readable message property.

1737:v2:8c6fff0fc930.title: Code search stops streaming when context lines exceed the output limit
1737:v2:8c6fff0fc930.summary: The PR moves the result limit check in `code_search` so it runs for every included JSON line, not just match events. This prevents searches with context flags from continuing to collect output beyond the configured budget. A new regression test confirms that hitting the budget with pending context lines settles the search early, sends SIGTERM, and reports the size limit notice.

1726:v2:c0aa3c2e44db.title: Adds encrypted local secrets and local model runtime detection
1726:v2:c0aa3c2e44db.summary: The pull request introduces a device-local secret vault that encrypts values using AES-256-GCM and binds them to process environments at the tool execution boundary. It also adds a local model discovery system that probes Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and vLLM on loopback interfaces to create BYOK connections for local inference.

1726:v2:11920d0c097b.title: Add device secrets and local model discovery
1726:v2:11920d0c097b.summary: The proposal adds a device-local encrypted secret vault and loopback-only discovery for four model runtimes to the public common, cli, and sdk packages. The vault keeps values out of the model context by injecting them only at the command or request boundary and redacting them from output, while the discovery feature probes local endpoints, saves a BYOK connection, and warns on likely memory overruns. Neither capability changes hosted behaviour or adds a new backend or dependency.

1730:v2:0269ae07b8dd.title: Replace shell command release triggers with typed fetch calls
1730:v2:0269ae07b8dd.summary: This PR refactors three release dispatch scripts to construct GitHub API requests as typed objects instead of interpolating credentials and command-line arguments into shell strings executed by execSync. It also corrects the success detection logic to check the HTTP status code rather than response body content, preventing false-positive celebrations on authentication failures.

1729:v2:67f3399599a1.title: Upgrade lodash to 4.18.1 in all package manifests
1729:v2:67f3399599a1.summary: This pull request updates the pinned version of lodash from 4.17.23 to 4.18.1 across the root, common, and agent-runtime package manifests along with the lockfile. 1728:v2:8274bebf7714.title: Report the real cause when the CLI test env fails to load
1728:v2:8274bebf7714.summary: The change replaces the `instanceof Error` check in the CLI test utility's `loadCliEnv` with a `describeEnvLoadFailure` helper that reads the `message` property from any thrown object. This ensures that Bun's `ResolveMessage` objects, which lack the `Error` prototype, report their specific module resolution failure instead of a generic "unknown error" message. A new test file verifies that the specific error details are preserved across different error shapes.

1740:v2:c2123c1ff0d4.title: Route shell probes and SDK scripts through argument arrays
1740:v2:c2123c1ff0d4.summary: This PR refactors the CLI shell detection utility and SDK publish and verify scripts to use `execFileSync` instead of `execSync`, passing command arguments as arrays rather than interpolated strings. The change ensures that process inspection and build automation steps never spawn child processes through a shell, preventing future injection risks when dynamic values are added. A new test suite overrides the platform property to guarantee the POSIX code path executes and verifies that the shell probe uses an argument list.

1741:v2:0939f51326e0.title: Preserve UTF-8 across terminal output chunks
1741:v2:0939f51326e0.summary: The PR introduces a `collectDecodedOutput` helper that uses a `StringDecoder` to accumulate stream chunks into decoded text for both foreground terminal streams and brokered background log files. This approach prevents multibyte UTF-8 characters from being split across data events and replaced with replacement characters, while leaving the raw stream encoding intact for other consumers.

1730:v2:43aa2270c1bf.title: Fix release workflow trigger security flaws and tests
1730:v2:43aa2270c1bf.summary: This PR rewrites three release scripts to use a direct fetch request instead of a shell curl command, preventing the GitHub token and version data from being exposed in process arguments. It also updates the success check to rely on the HTTP response status instead of parsing the response body, and adds tests to verify that the release trigger cannot be executed by simply importing the module.

1742:v2:07caedc54ff2.title: Fix SDK file read errors for inherited object keys
1742:v2:07caedc54ff2.summary: The proposed change refactors the file read logic in read-files.ts to use applyFileReadWindows instead of manual array mapping, preventing a specific error when fileWindows is an ordinary object with inherited keys like constructor. This PR also adds a regression test to ensure files with such names read correctly when an adjacent file is windowed.

1712:v2:bcc07d3fdfff.title: Add VPS deployment and diagnostics for opencode-hub
1712:v2:bcc07d3fdfff.summary: The proposal introduces a `deploy` directory containing a Docker Compose stack, Caddyfile, and helper scripts for hosting a new `opencode-hub` package on a VPS. 1745:v2:002c5c20aaf6.title: Deduplicate overlapping json code search results
1745:v2:002c5c20aaf6.summary: The SDK code search tool normalizes file paths by stripping redundant root prefixes before grouping json records, ensuring per-file limits apply consistently across overlapping search roots. It tracks retained records by normalized path, record type, and byte offset in both streaming and final-buffer parsing to prevent duplicate matches from consuming the result budget twice. A new regression test verifies that overlapping hidden and visible roots count each distinct match exactly once under a limited global result cap.

1712:v2:8f38976d1f15.title: Add one-command VPS deploy and diagnostic script for opencode-hub
1712:v2:8f38976d1f15.summary: The PR introduces a dedicated `opencode-hub` module with Docker Compose and Caddy configurations to deploy the hub and opencode agent on a permanent VPS. It provides `install.sh` and `bootstrap.sh` scripts for automated setup, including Docker installation, DNS verification, and HTTPS certificate provisioning. A `doctor.sh` script is also included to diagnose deployment issues such as DNS resolution, port conflicts, and container health.

1742:v2:9f7b7a55a602.title: Handle inherited window keys in SDK file reads
1742:v2:9f7b7a55a602.summary: This PR updates the SDK's file reading tool to safely handle cases where the window map lacks a specific entry but inherits a truthy property like a constructor. It replaces the manual array check with a shared helper function to prevent errors when processing files with names that collide with object prototypes. A regression test is added to verify that reading such files alongside explicitly windowed files works correctly.

1741:v2:29fbd3faa125.title: Preserve multibyte characters across chunked terminal output
1741:v2:29fbd3faa125.summary: This change introduces a stream-level string decoder so that UTF-8 characters split across multiple chunks are reconstructed correctly instead of being replaced with a substitution character in foreground and background terminal logs. The decoder maintains independent state per stream and flushes at end of stream, ensuring raw byte consumers are unaffected and ANSI escape sequences remain intact.

1745:v2:cf1c135b08b7.title: Fix duplicate JSON code search results from overlapping roots
1745:v2:cf1c135b08b7.summary: The PR proposes normalizing redundant leading path segments before grouping JSON records in the code search tool. It adds a deduplication mechanism that tracks retained records by normalized path, event type, and byte offset to prevent overlapping search roots from consuming result budgets twice. A regression test verifies that fixtures with multiple matching lines report the correct count under global result limits.

1740:v2:0b6ab9afd0a0.title: Use array arguments for shell process calls in CLI and SDK
1740:v2:0b6ab9afd0a0.summary: This pull request replaces string-based command execution with array arguments in the CLI shell detection utility and SDK publish and verify scripts to avoid shell parsing. It updates helper functions to accept structured arguments so that interpolated values are treated as data rather than syntax. A new test file is added to verify that the POSIX parent process inspection uses the expected argument structure.

1737:v2:df07aa1a8276.title: Enforce output budget for ripgrep context lines
1737:v2:df07aa1a8276.summary: This pull request updates the `code_search` tool to evaluate the output size budget on every emitted line, rather than only when a new match is detected. It also includes a regression test that verifies the search terminates early and requests termination of the underlying process when context lines exhaust the limit.

1712:v2:d41f25f95a11.title: Add VPS deployment and diagnostics for opencode hub
1712:v2:d41f25f95a11.summary: The PR adds a `deploy` directory containing a Docker Compose stack with Caddy, installation scripts, and a diagnostic tool to host the opencode hub on a virtual private server with HTTPS. 1712:v2:aa67808ebe16.title: Add VPS deploy and diagnostic script for opencode-hub
1712:v2:aa67808ebe16.summary: The PR proposes a new `opencode-hub` deployment stack that enables persistent hosting on a virtual private server. It includes a one-command installer, a read-only diagnostic script, and a Docker Compose configuration with Caddy for automated HTTPS and basic authentication.

1749:v2:65fa227589b7.title: Key remote MCP client cache by header hash
1749:v2:65fa227589b7.summary: This PR proposes adding a SHA-256 digest of environment-resolved request headers to the cache identity for HTTP and SSE Model Context Protocol clients. By incorporating this hash, the system prevents different authorization identities from reusing the same transport and tool catalog when connecting to the same endpoint. A new regression test with a real loopback server verifies that distinct header configurations generate unique client instances while identical configurations are reused correctly.
